map.学习率预热步数 使用指南: Learning Rate Warmup Steps User Guide
map.依据总训练步数与预热比例，计算学习率线性预热的步数区间，适用于稳定训练初期、避免: From total training steps and warmup ratio, compute the step range for linear learning rate warmup, for stabilizing early training and avoiding gradient oscillation in scheduler design.
map.预热步数 = 总步数 × 比例；预热末 LR = 峰值 LR: Warmup steps = total steps × ratio; LR at the end of warmup = peak LR
map.训练最初若干步把学习率从 0 线性升到峰值，给 Adam 的二阶动量估计留出稳定: In the first few training steps the learning rate rises linearly from 0 to the peak, giving Adam's second moment estimate time to stabilize and avoiding divergence from large gradient variance at the start of large-batch training. A typical setting is 1%-5% of total steps, followed by cosine or linear decay.
map.预热步数=总步数×预热比例；期间 lr 从 0(或很小)线性升到峰值。: Warmup steps = total steps × warmup ratio; during it lr rises linearly from 0 (or very small) to the peak.
map.避免训练初期大 lr 破坏随机初始化、造成梯度震荡或不稳定。: Avoid a large lr at the start destroying random initialization and causing gradient oscillation or instability.
map.常用预热比例 0~10%，与余弦衰减衔接形成 warmup+decay 调度。: Commonly 0 to 10%, joined with cosine decay to form a warmup+decay schedule.
map.：总步数 10000、预热比例 5% → 预热步数=500，前 500 步 lr: : total steps 10,000, warmup ratio 5% -> warmup steps = 500; for the first 500 steps lr rises linearly from 0 to the peak (for example 1e-3), then decay begins. Without warmup, 1e-3 on the first step tends to oscillate.
map.大模型/大 batch 通常必要，能稳定初期训练；小模型小学习率可省略。跳过预热: Usually needed for large models or large batches, since it stabilizes early training; small models with small learning rates can skip it. Skipping warmup often causes a first-epoch loss spike or even NaN.
map.常见 0~10%，Transformer 训练多用 1%~6%；过大则有效训练步: Commonly 0 to 10%, with Transformer training mostly 1% to 6%; too large wastes effective training steps, too small gives insufficient protection, so judge by whether the validation curve is smooth.
